title: Blender and Astra Jungle Assets and Demo (With Code)
author: MediocreHelicopter19
selftext:
An initial workflow for using GPT-6 Astra / Codex with Blender. It generated some GLB assets and textures. Astra wrote the texture prompts, then I generated them in the ChatGPT web UI.

All on a Plus account. Three 5-hour token-limit cycles to build the full repo, including the demo. Plenty of room for improvement.

This is a quick test to see if I could get some decent looking assets with Astra without breaking the bank..

Demo: [https://danielsobrado.github.io/Codex-and-Blender/](https://danielsobrado.github.io/Codex-and-Blender/)  
Repo: [https://github.com/danielsobrado/Codex-and-Blender](https://github.com/danielsobrado/Codex-and-Blender)

comments.author: RepulsiveRaisin7
comments.body:
Pretty impressive! How did it build the meshes, blender scripting?

I've experimented with this a bunch, it works for simple meshes but when it gets complex and artistic, it's kinda difficult to describe what you want. Astra was not that good at translating concept art into a real model. But give it a year or two and it'll easily replace humans.

replies.author: MediocreHelicopter19
replies.body: I asked Astra to read the instructions of the repo, then I gave Astra some reference images (Screenshots from a game) and asked to create the assets, give me the prompts for the textures and where to place them and after that to generate the scene in threejs, the last part was to optimize the assets so it loads fast and is performant
